title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-233. Perjury
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-233. Perjury (2023)
content:
Anyone who shall wilfully and corruptly make a false statement under any oath or affirmation
   provided for in this act, or in any document required to be executed by this act or
   anyone who shall by means procure or suborn any other person to do so, shall be guilty
   of the crime of perjury and upon conviction thereof, shall be subject to the same
   punishment as is or may be provided by law for perjury.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-232. Doing business by a foreign corporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-232. Doing business by a foreign corporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-232. Doing business by a foreign corporation (2023)
content:
Any individual who shall violate the provisions of section 13011of this act shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof, be
   subject to imprisonment for a period not exceeding one year or a fine not exceeding
   one thousand dollars ($1,000) or both.  He shall also be subject to a further fine equal to any moneys received by him within
   this Commonwealth in violation of said section.  The corporation which such individual represents shall be guilty of a misdemeanor
   and upon conviction thereof shall be subject to a fine of five thousand dollars ($5,000).  Such corporation shall be subject to a further fine equal to the amount of any moneys
   received by such corporation or its agent in violation of this section.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-234. Acceptance of fee for procuring loan
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-234. Acceptance of fee for procuring loan
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-234. Acceptance of fee for procuring loan (2023)
content:
Any director, officer, attorney, or employe of an association who knowingly violates
   the provision of subsection (a)(1) of section 5101of this act shall be guilty of a misdemeanor, and shall, upon conviction thereof,
   be subject to a fine not exceeding a sum equal to three times the amount of the value
   of the property which he received as such fee, commission or gift.  In addition he shall be disqualified from acting as an officer, director, attorney,
   or employe of any association within this Commonwealth for a period of five years
   after the date of such conviction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XIV. Provisions Applicable to Department of Banking›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-222. Relationship of savings associations and their personnel with officials and employes of the department
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XIV. Provisions Applicable to Department of Banking › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-222. Relationship of savings associations and their personnel with officials and employes of the department
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-222. Relationship of savings associations and their personnel with officials and employes of the department (2023)
content:
(a) Except as provided in subsection (c) of this section a savings association or
      any director, officer, employe or attorney thereof shall not grant or give to the
      Secretary of Banking, any official or employe of the department, any deputy or any
      employe of the Secretary of Banking as receiver, any sum of money or any property
      as a gift, loan or otherwise, directly or indirectly--subject to the penalty provisions
      of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XIV. Provisions Applicable to Department of Banking›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-221. Examinations and reports
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XIV. Provisions Applicable to Department of Banking › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-221. Examinations and reports
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-221. Examinations and reports (2023)
content:
(a) The department shall examine all associations at least once every two calendar
      years and may examine any association more frequently and at any time it deems such
      action necessary or desirable for protection of members or creditors.  The examination shall include a review of the accounts, records and affairs of the
      association, its compliance with law and such other matters as the department may
      determine.  For this purpose the department may examine a person which is performing services
      for an association.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-237. Repledging of collateral
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-237. Repledging of collateral

content:
Any officer, director or employe of an association who knowingly violates section
   112 of this act1shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars ($1,000),
   or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-240. Relationship of savings associations and their personnel with officials and employes of the department
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-240. Relationship of savings associations and their personnel with officials and employes of the department (2023)
content:
Any director, officer, attorney or employe of an association, or the Secretary of
   Banking, or any employe, or any official of the department who knowingly violates
   the provisions of either subsection (a) or subsection (b) of section 14021shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof, be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars ($1,000),
   or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-236. Failure to keep proper accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-236. Failure to keep proper accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-236. Failure to keep proper accounts (2023)
content:
Any director, officer or employe of an association who knowingly violates the provisions
   of section 110 of this act1shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars ($1,000),
   or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-239. Transacting business before certificate of authorization issued
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-239. Transacting business before certificate of authorization issued
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-239. Transacting business before certificate of authorization issued (2023)
content:
Any officer or director of an association who knowingly violates section 209(a) of
   this act1shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars ($1,000),
   or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-235. Dealings between an association and its directors, officers, employes and attorneys
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-235. Dealings between an association and its directors, officers, employes and attorneys
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-235. Dealings between an association and its directors, officers, employes and attorneys (2023)
content:
Any officer, director, attorney or employe of an association who knowingly violates
   the provisions of either subsection (a)(2) or subsection (a)(3) of section 5101shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof, be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year, or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars
   ($1,000), or both.  He shall also be subject to a further fine equal to any profit which he shall have
   made upon the transaction.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XVI. Effective Date and Repealers › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-254. Transition provisions

content: In the interpretation and construction of this act:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-8. Notices
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-8. Notices
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-8. Notices (2023)
content:
(a) Written notice required to be given to any person under the provisions of this
      act or under the articles or bylaws of an association may be given to such person,
      either personally or by sending a copy thereof through the mail, or by telegram, charges
      prepaid, to his address appearing on the books of the association, or supplied by
      him to the association for the purpose of notice.  If the notice is sent by mail or by telegraph, it shall be deemed to have been given
      to the person entitled thereto when deposited in the United States mail or with a
      telegraph office for transmission to such person.  If such notice is of a meeting, it shall specify the place, date and hour of the
      meeting, and, in the case of a special meeting of members, the general nature of the
      business to be transacted.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-9. Execution of instruments
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-9. Execution of instruments
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-9. Execution of instruments (2023)
content:
Without regard to any other form of execution provided in the bylaws, an instrument
   in writing, or any assignment or endorsement thereof, executed or entered into between
   an association and any person and signed by the president or vice-president and by
   the secretary or treasurer of the association, shall be held to have been properly
   executed by and in behalf of the association.  Except as otherwise required by statute, the affixation of the corporate seal shall
   not be necessary to the valid execution, assignment or endorsement by an association
   of any instrument in writing.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-5. Emergency powers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-5. Emergency powers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-5. Emergency powers (2023)
content:
In the event a nuclear attack or other disaster results in the declaration of an emergency
   an association may during the continuance of such emergency, without regard to any
   restriction or limitation of this act, take any action to preserve the assets of the
   association and to continue or resume its business, including any action to obtain
   the benefit of, or participate in, emergency action authorized by the Federal government.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-10. Books, records and accounts of associations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-10. Books, records and accounts of associations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-10. Books, records and accounts of associations (2023)
content:
(a) An association may maintain its books of account on a cash, accrual, or modified
      accrual basis, as determined by the board of directors.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-21. Incorporators
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-21. Incorporators
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-21. Incorporators (2023)
content: (a) A savings association may be incorporated by three or more adults.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-6. Certificates and certified copies of documents to be received in evidence
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-6. Certificates and certified copies of documents to be received in evidence
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-6. Certificates and certified copies of documents to be received in evidence (2023)
content:
All certificates issued by the Department of Banking and by the Department of State
   and all copies of articles, papers and other documents filed in either department
   and certified by the Secretary of the Department of Banking or by the Secretary of
   the Commonwealth shall be taken and received by all courts, public offices, and official
   bodies as prima facie evidence of the facts therein stated.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-16. Federal agency references
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-16. Federal agency references
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-16. Federal agency references (2023)
content:
(a) Any reference in this act to the Federal Home Loan Bank Board shall mean the Office
      of Thrift Supervision under section 3 of the Home Owners' Loan Act (48 Stat. 128,12 U.S.C. § 1462a).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-11. Retention of records and admissibility of copies in evidence
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-11. Retention of records and admissibility of copies in evidence
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-11. Retention of records and admissibility of copies in evidence (2023)
content:
(a) Every association shall preserve in such form and manner that they may be readily
      produced upon proper demand, all of its records of original or final entries for a
      period of seven years from the date of making the last entry thereon, except that
      coupons accompanying deposits in a club account, such as a Christmas club or a vacation
      club, need not be so retained for more than two years from the date of closing of
      such account.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-13. Statutory amendment of existing charters
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-13. Statutory amendment of existing charters
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-13. Statutory amendment of existing charters (2023)
content:
The charters of all existing building and loan associations and savings and loan associations
   heretofore granted shall be deemed to be amended to the extent necessary to give effect
   to the provisions of this act and to conform thereto.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-22. Prohibition of promoters' fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-22. Prohibition of promoters' fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-22. Prohibition of promoters' fees (2023)
content:
(a) A savings association shall not pay any fee, compensation or commission for the
      promotion or organization of an association or for any part of the money collected
      from members, except legal fees and other usual and ordinary expenses necessary for
      its organization.  Any incorporator, officer, director or employe paying or receiving any such fee,
      compensation or commission shall be subject to the penalty provisions of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-7. Advertisement
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-7. Advertisement
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-7. Advertisement (2023)
content:
(a) Every advertisement required by this act shall be published, except as otherwise
      provided in this act, once in a newspaper of general circulation and once in a legal
      newspaper.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-12. Repledging of collateral
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-12. Repledging of collateral
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-12. Repledging of collateral (2023)
content: (a) An association shall not repledge any property held by it in pledge or as collateral.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-23. Articles of incorporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-23. Articles of incorporation

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-27. Issuance of certificate of incorporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-27. Issuance of certificate of incorporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-27. Issuance of certificate of incorporation (2023)
content:
If all the taxes, fees and charges required by law shall have been paid and if the
   name of the proposed association continues to be reserved or is available on the records
   of the Department of State the receipt of the articles by the Department of State
   with the written approval of the department shall constitute filing of the articles
   with the Department of State as of the date and time of receipt or as of any later
   date and time specified by the department and the Department of State shall immediately
   issue to the incorporators a certificate of incorporation as of the date and time
   of filing with the approved articles attached thereto and shall make and retain a
   copy of such certificate and articles.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-26. Approval of proposed association by department
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-26. Approval of proposed association by department
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-26. Approval of proposed association by department (2023)
content:
(a) Upon receipt of an application for approval of a proposed association the department
      shall conduct such investigation as it may deem necessary to ascertain whether:

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-30. Organization meetings (2023)
content:
(a) After the filing of the articles in the Department of State the first meeting
      of the members shall be held within this Commonwealth at the call of the incorporators,
      or the majority of them, for the purpose of adopting such bylaws as this act and the
      articles require to be adopted by the members, and for such other purposes as shall
      be stated in the notice of the meeting.  The incorporators, at the call of the meeting, shall give to each member at least
      five days' written notice of the time and place of the meeting.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-31. Adoption and contents of bylaws
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-31. Adoption and contents of bylaws
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-31. Adoption and contents of bylaws (2023)
content:
(a) The members shall have the power to make, alter, amend and repeal the bylaws of
      an association, but such authority may be expressly vested by the articles or by the
      bylaws in the board of directors (except as to bylaws fixing the qualification, classification,
      or terms of office of directors), subject to the power of the members to change such
      action.  Unless the articles or bylaws otherwise provide, the powers hereby conferred shall
      be exercised by a majority vote of the directors or by the majority vote of members
      of the association present in person or by proxy at any regular or special meeting.  No notice shall be required to members for any regular meeting where such bylaw
      changes are to be considered.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-29. Certificate of authorization to do business
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-29. Certificate of authorization to do business
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-29. Certificate of authorization to do business (2023)
content:
(a) Until receipt of a certificate of authorization issued by the department an association
      shall not open savings accounts for its members, incur indebtedness or transact any
      business except such business as is incident to its organization or to the obtaining
      of subscriptions.  Any officer or director violating this prohibition shall be subject to the penalty
      provisions of this act.

content:
(a) Upon receipt of an application for approval of a branch which satisfies the requirements
      of this act and the payment of all fees, and after such further notice as the department
      may require, the department shall conduct such investigation as it may deem necessary
      and in its discretion may hold hearings.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article III. Names›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-43. Reservation of name

content:
(a) The exclusive right to use a name permitted to be used by an association under
      this act may be reserved by an individual intending to incorporate an association,
      by an association intending to change its name, or by a Federal savings and loan association
      intending to convert into a State association.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-61. Board of directors

content: (a) The business and affairs of an association shall be managed by a board of directors.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-62. Number and qualifications of directors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-62. Number and qualifications of directors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-62. Number and qualifications of directors (2023)
content: (a) The bylaws shall fix the number of directors at not less than five.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-67. Officers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-67. Officers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-67. Officers (2023)
content:
(a) An association shall have a president, a secretary and a treasurer and such other
      officers, including a conveyancer, as it may authorize.  The bylaws may provide that the same individual may hold two offices except that
      the president shall not hold any other office.  The president shall be a member of the board of directors.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-65. Communications from Department of Banking
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-65. Communications from Department of Banking
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-65. Communications from Department of Banking (2023)
content:
Every official communication directed by the department to an association, or to any
   officer thereof, shall be transmitted by the officer receiving it to the board of
   directors at the next meeting of such board, and shall be duly noted in the minutes
   of such meeting.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-63. Term of office of directors; vacancies; classification of directors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-63. Term of office of directors; vacancies; classification of directors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-63. Term of office of directors; vacancies; classification of directors (2023)
content:
(a) Each director shall hold office for the term for which he is elected and until
      his successor shall have been duly elected and qualified.  Directors shall be elected by the members for a term of one year except as otherwise
      provided in this article or in the articles or the bylaws.

content: Except as otherwise provided in this act or in the articles or bylaws:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-68. Bonds
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-68. Bonds
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-68. Bonds (2023)
content:
Each officer and employe and any director who is authorized to handle money or negotiable
   assets on behalf of the association shall be bonded and the association may pay the
   cost of such bond.  The form, amount and surety of such bonds shall be such as is approved by the board
   of directors, but the department may require an additional amount or new or additional
   surety.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-71. Audits and reports
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-71. Audits and reports
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-71. Audits and reports (2023)
content:
(a) Except as provided in subsection (c) of this section the board of directors of
      an association shall cause an annual audit to be made of the books, papers, securities
      and affairs of an association and the loans thereof and such other matters as the
      department may require and such audit shall be made by an independent public accountant
      satisfactory to the department.  The department may by regulation establish minimum standards for audits and reports
      under this subsection (a).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-74. Department review of additions of any director or senior executive officer
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-74. Department review of additions of any director or senior executive officer
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-74. Department review of additions of any director or senior executive officer (2023)
content:
(a) An insured association or a Pennsylvania thrift institution holding company shall
      notify the department of the proposed addition of any individual as a senior executive
      officer of such institution or holding company at least thirty days before such addition
      or employment becomes effective, if the insured association or the Pennsylvania thrift
      institution holding company:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-81. Meetings of members
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-81. Meetings of members
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-81. Meetings of members (2023)
content:
(a) Meetings of the members of an association shall be held at such place within the
      Commonwealth as shall be fixed by the bylaws or by the board of directors pursuant
      to the bylaws, or if none is so fixed, at the principal place of business of the association.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-84. Voting rights of members
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-84. Voting rights of members

content:
(a) Except as otherwise provided in this act at every meeting of the members of an

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-82. Notice of meetings of members
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-82. Notice of meetings of members
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-82. Notice of meetings of members (2023)
content:
(a) If the time and place of a regular meeting of the members are stated in the bylaws,
      it shall be sufficient, in addition to any other notice, if any, required by the bylaws,
      to post a notice at the place of business of the association during the month immediately
      preceding the date of such meeting.  Written notice of each special meeting of members and of each regular meeting, the
      time and place of which are not stated in the bylaws, shall be given to each member
      of record entitled to vote at the meeting at least five days prior to the date thereof,
      unless a longer period of notice is required by the articles, bylaws, or other provisions
      of this act.  The notice required by this section shall specify the place, day and hour of the
      meeting, and, in the case of a special meeting, the general nature of the business
      to be transacted.  Notice of an adjourned meeting and of the business to be transacted at such meeting
      may be given by announcement at the meeting at which the adjournment is taken unless
      otherwise provided in the articles or bylaws.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-83. Quorum and action by members
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-83. Quorum and action by members
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-83. Quorum and action by members (2023)
content:
(a) A meeting of the members duly called shall not be organized for the transaction
      of business unless a quorum is present.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-85. Voting by fiduciaries and pledgors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-85. Voting by fiduciaries and pledgors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-85. Voting by fiduciaries and pledgors (2023)
content:
(a) Savings accounts standing in the name of a fiduciary may be voted either in person
      or by proxy of the fiduciary.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-89. Judges of election
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-89. Judges of election

content: (a) One judge or three judges of election may be appointed:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-90. Informal action by members
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-90. Informal action by members
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-90. Informal action by members (2023)
content:
Any action which may be taken at a meeting of members may, unless otherwise provided
   in the articles or bylaws, be taken without a meeting, if a consent or consents in
   writing, setting forth the action so taken, shall be signed by all the members who
   would be entitled to vote on such action at a meeting and shall be filed with the
   secretary of the association.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-88. Determination of members of record
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-88. Determination of members of record
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-88. Determination of members of record (2023)
content:
(a) The board of directors of an association may, except as otherwise provided in
      its bylaws, fix a date for the determination of the members entitled to receive notice
      of and to vote at any meeting or to receive any distribution or allotment of rights
      or a date for any change, conversion or exchange of savings accounts by:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-87. Voting rights held by corporations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-87. Voting rights held by corporations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-87. Voting rights held by corporations (2023)
content:
An association or other corporation which holds voting rights of an association may
   vote the same by:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-86. Voting by joint holders of savings accounts and by joint mortgagors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-86. Voting by joint holders of savings accounts and by joint mortgagors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-86. Voting by joint holders of savings accounts and by joint mortgagors (2023)
content:
(a) Voting rights which are held jointly or as tenants in common by two or more persons,
      as fiduciaries or otherwise, shall be deemed to be represented for the purpose of
      determining a quorum if one or more such persons are present in person or by proxy.  Except as provided in subsection (b) of this section, the vote shall be the vote
      cast by such persons or a majority of such persons but if such persons are equally
      divided upon the manner of voting, the voting rights held by them shall be divided
      equally among such persons, without prejudice to the rights of such joint owners or
      the beneficial owners thereof among themselves.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-91. Immunity of savings account members
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-91. Immunity of savings account members
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-91. Immunity of savings account members (2023)
content:
A savings account member of an association shall not, merely by reason of his ownership
   of savings or voting rights, be personally liable for any debt or liability of the
   association.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-111. No limitation on savings accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-111. No limitation on savings accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-111. No limitation on savings accounts (2023)
content:
An association may receive money for savings accounts without limitation as to number
   and amount of such accounts unless the board of directors shall fix limits therefor.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-92. Disclosure of information concerning accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-92. Disclosure of information concerning accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-92. Disclosure of information concerning accounts (2023)

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-113. Savings contracts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-113. Savings contracts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-113. Savings contracts (2023)
content:
Each holder of a savings account opened or created after the effective date of this
   act shall execute a savings contract setting forth any special terms and provisions
   applicable to such account and the conditions upon which withdrawals may be made not
   inconsistent with the provisions of this act.  Such savings contract shall be held by the association as part of its records pertaining
   to such account.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-112. Ownership
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-112. Ownership
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-112. Ownership (2023)
content:
Investments in savings accounts may be made only with cash and may be made by any
   person or persons in his or their own right or in a trust or other fiduciary capacity
   and by any partnership, association, corporation, political subdivision, public or
   governmental unit or entity.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VII. Corporate Powers›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-101. Powers of associations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VII. Corporate Powers › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-101. Powers of associations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-101. Powers of associations (2023)
content:
(a) Every association incorporated pursuant to or operating under the provisions of
      this code shall have all of the powers enumerated, authorized, and permitted by this
      code and such other rights, privileges and powers as may be incidental to or reasonably
      necessary or appropriate for the accomplishment of the objects and purposes of the
      association.  Among others, and except as otherwise limited by the provisions of this code, every
      association shall have the following powers:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-117. Savings accounts of minors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-117. Savings accounts of minors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-117. Savings accounts of minors (2023)
content:
An association may open savings accounts in the name of a minor as the sole and absolute
   owner of such savings account and receive payments thereon by or for such owner and
   pay withdrawals, accept pledges to the association and act in any other manner with
   respect to such accounts on the order of the minor.  Any payment to a minor or a receipt or acquittance signed by the minor or any other
   action required by the association to be taken by the minor shall be binding upon
   such minor with like effect as if such minor were of full age and legal capacity and
   shall be a valid release to the association.  The parent or guardian of such minor shall not, in his capacity as parent or guardian,
   have the power to attach, or in any manner transfer, any savings account owned and
   standing in the name of such minor.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-115. Evidence of ownership of an account
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-115. Evidence of ownership of an account
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-115. Evidence of ownership of an account (2023)
content:
The association shall issue to the holder of a savings account either an account book,
   a certificate or other evidence of ownership.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-116. Transfer of savings accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-116. Transfer of savings accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-116. Transfer of savings accounts (2023)
content:
Savings accounts shall be transferable only on the books of the association upon presentation
   of evidence of transfer satisfactory to the association accompanied by proper application
   for transfer by the transferee who shall accept such account subject to the terms
   and conditions of the savings contract, the bylaws of the association and the provisions
   of its articles of incorporation.  The association may treat the holder of record of a savings account as the owner
   thereof for all purposes without being affected by any notice to the contrary unless
   the association has acknowledged in writing the interest of persons other than the
   holder of record.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-118. Savings accounts in two or more names
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-118. Savings accounts in two or more names
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-118. Savings accounts in two or more names (2023)
content:
(a) When a savings account is opened in any association in the names of two or more
      persons whether minor or adult and the savings contract provides that the moneys in
      such account may be paid to or on the order of any one of such persons, then the association
      may pay the moneys in such account to or on the order of any one of such persons either
      before or after the death of the other person or persons named on such account and
      such association shall have no further liability for the amount so paid.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-119. Pledge to association of joint savings accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-119. Pledge to association of joint savings accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-119. Pledge to association of joint savings accounts (2023)
content:
The pledge or hypothecation to any association of all or part of a savings account
   issued in the names of two or more persons signed by any person or persons upon whose
   signature or signatures withdrawal may be made from the account shall, unless the
   terms of the savings account provide specifically to the contrary, be a valid pledge
   and transfer to the association of that part of the account pledged or hypothecated
   and shall not operate to sever or terminate the joint and survivorship ownership of
   all or any part of the account.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-121. Trust accounts where trust instrument is not disclosed
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-121. Trust accounts where trust instrument is not disclosed
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-121. Trust accounts where trust instrument is not disclosed (2023)
content:
Whenever an account shall be opened by any person, describing himself in opening such
   account as a trustee for another person or persons and no other or further notice
   of the existence and terms of a legal and valid trust than such description shall
   have been given in writing to such association, withdrawals from such account may
   be made on the signature of the person so described as trustee, and in the event of
   the death of such person, the withdrawal value of such account, or any part thereof,
   together with earnings thereon, may be paid to the person or persons for whom the
   account was thus stated to be opened.  The receipt or acquittance of any such beneficiary or beneficiaries for the payments
   made in accordance with this section shall be a full, complete and valid release of
   the association from any further liability for the amounts so paid.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-120. Savings accounts of fiduciaries
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-120. Savings accounts of fiduciaries
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-120. Savings accounts of fiduciaries (2023)
content:
If the fiduciary is permitted by law to make such investments an association may accept
   savings accounts in the name of any administrator, executor, custodian, guardian,
   trustee or other fiduciary for a named beneficiary or beneficiaries and any such fiduciary
   shall have the power to vote as a member as if the membership were held absolutely,
   to open and make additions to, and to withdraw from any such account in whole or in
   part.  Except when otherwise provided by law, the payment to any such fiduciary or a receipt
   or acquittance signed by such fiduciary to whom any payment is made shall be a valid
   and sufficient release and discharge of an association for the payment so made.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-122. Powers of attorney on savings accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-122. Powers of attorney on savings accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-122. Powers of attorney on savings accounts (2023)
content:
Any association may continue to recognize the authority of an attorney-in-fact authorized
   in writing to manage or to make withdrawals either in whole or in part from the savings
   account of a member until it receives written notice or is on actual notice of revocation
   of his authority.  For the purposes of this section, written notice of the death or adjudication of
   incompetency of such member shall constitute written notice of revocation of the authority
   of his attorney-in-fact.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-114. Types of savings contracts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-114. Types of savings contracts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-114. Types of savings contracts (2023)
content:
(a) An association may make any type of savings account contract including a savings
      deposit account, a savings account subject to withdrawal on demand, and an optional
      type savings account subject to withdrawal by a Negotiable Order of Withdrawal.  Savings accounts shall be issued in accordance with such regulations as the department
      shall prescribe.  No type of account may be created by any association which imposes fines as penalties
      for late payment or nonpayment for a period of longer than six months.  The resolution of the board creating the account may provide for transfer of the
      account at the termination of this period to another type of account.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-123. Withdrawals from savings accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-123. Withdrawals from savings accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-123. Withdrawals from savings accounts (2023)
content:
Any savings account member may at any time withdraw all or any part of his savings
   account, including the right to effect such withdrawals by travelers' convenience
   withdrawals.  If the savings account contract provides for withdrawal on demand, a savings account
   may be subject to withdrawal by check.  An optional type savings account may be subject to withdrawal by a Negotiable Order
   of Withdrawal.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-126. Authorizing payment of earnings or interest on savings accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-126. Authorizing payment of earnings or interest on savings accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-126. Authorizing payment of earnings or interest on savings accounts (2023)
content:
The board of directors shall determine the earnings or interest, if any, to be credited
   not less frequently than annually to savings accounts on the books of the association
   unless a savings account holder shall have requested and the association shall have
   agreed to pay earnings or interest on such savings account in cash.  Earnings or interest payable in cash may be paid by check or bank draft.  All accounts of the same type and class shall be paid the same rate of earnings
   or interest.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-128. Earnings not distributed
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-128. Earnings not distributed
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-128. Earnings not distributed (2023)
content:
An association may provide by resolution of its board of directors that it shall not
   distribute earnings on any savings account of less than a minimum amount fixed by
   such resolution, which amount shall be not more than fifty dollars ($50), or on any
   Christmas club, vacation club or other similar account in which the account is listed
   for withdrawal no later than fifteen months after the date of opening;  and may, by
   resolution of its board of directors, fix a lesser amount than such minimum with respect
   to the distribution of earnings on savings accounts established in connection with
   a program offered by such association to children for the encouragement of thrift.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-125. Lien on savings accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-125. Lien on savings accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-125. Lien on savings accounts (2023)
content:
Every association shall have a lien, without further agreement or pledge, upon all
   savings accounts owned by any member to whom or on whose behalf the association has
   made an advance of money by loan or otherwise and upon the default in the repayment
   or satisfaction thereof the association may, without notice to or consent of the member,
   cancel on its books all or any part of the savings accounts owned by such member and
   apply the value of such accounts in payment on account of such obligation.  An association may by written instrument waive its lien in whole or in part on any
   savings accounts.  Any association may take the pledge of savings accounts of the association owned
   by a member other than the borrower as additional security for any loan secured by
   an account, or by an account and real estate, or as additional security for any real
   estate loan.  Notwithstanding any other provision of this section, no association shall have a
   lien upon a savings account as a result of a default on any real estate loan, unless
   the said account is specifically pledged as security for the said real estate loan.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-124. Redemption of savings accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-124. Redemption of savings accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-124. Redemption of savings accounts (2023)
content:
At any time funds are on hand for the purpose, an association shall have the right
   to redeem by lot or otherwise, as the board of directors may determine, all or any
   part of any of its savings accounts on an earnings date by giving thirty days' notice
   by registered or certified mail, addressed to each affected account holder at his
   last address as recorded on the books of the association.  No association shall redeem any of its savings accounts when the association is
   subject to receivership action under the provisions of this act or when it has applications
   for withdrawal which have been on file more than thirty days and have not been reached
   for payment.  The redemption price of savings accounts redeemed shall be the withdrawal value
   thereof.  If the notice of redemption shall have been duly given and if on or before the redemption
   date the funds necessary for such redemption shall have been set aside so as to be
   and continue to be available therefor, earnings upon the accounts called for redemption
   shall cease to accrue from and after the earnings date specified as the redemption
   date and all rights with respect to such accounts shall forthwith, after such redemption
   date, terminate, except only the right of the account holder of record to receive
   the redemption price.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-131. No duty on an association to determine ownership of funds placed in savings accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-131. No duty on an association to determine ownership of funds placed in savings accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-131. No duty on an association to determine ownership of funds placed in savings accounts (2023)
content:
An association shall be under no duty to determine the ownership of funds received
   by it for savings accounts, but shall be entitled to rely on the savings account contract
   with the named owners.  An association shall not be liable to any person claiming to be the owner, part
   owner, joint owner or beneficiary in any savings account unless such person is named
   as owner or beneficiary therein or the association is supplied with a decree or order
   of court determining ownership.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-130. Inactive accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-130. Inactive accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-130. Inactive accounts (2023)
content:
Savings on which no payments have been made and on which earnings are unclaimed for
   a period of six years or longer may be listed for withdrawal by action of the association's
   board of directors without regard to any other provisions or limitations of the statute.  Notice of such action shall forthwith be mailed to the holder of such savings at
   his last known address.  Any such withdrawals that remain unclaimed after thirty days from the mailing of
   such notice may be placed in a special account held solely for the purpose of paying
   any future claims of the rightful owners thereof.  Earnings shall cease to accrue on such withdrawals after the placing of the funds
   in the special account.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-127. Accounts subject to attachment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-127. Accounts subject to attachment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-127. Accounts subject to attachment (2023)
content:
Savings accounts of associations and Federal savings and loan associations shall be
   subject exclusively to attachment or any similar process and shall not be subject
   to levy and sale on execution or proceedings supplementary thereto.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-129. Service charge
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-129. Service charge
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-129. Service charge (2023)
content:
An association may make a service charge of not more than five dollars ($5) in any
   calendar year against any savings account if at the time any such charge is made:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-133.1. Dissolution
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-133.1. Dissolution
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-133.1. Dissolution (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding section 1207,1a PSAIC insured association which fails to file a substantially complete application
   for Federal insurance of its accounts as an insured institution or an application
   with the department or any Federal banking regulator as required by law for merger
   with an existing federally insured institution or an application to merge with or
   convert to a credit union within the time period set forth in section 8232may be subject to the imposition of a plan of dissolution by the department.  The distribution of assets shall be in accordance with section 1208.3Additionally, the department may appoint a conservator to the association who shall
   have full authority to wind up the affairs of the association, including filing dissolution
   documents with the department or other relevant agency.  The board of directors and the members shall have no authority upon appointment
   of a conservator.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-133.2. PSAIC
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-133.2. PSAIC
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-133.2. PSAIC (2023)
content:
(a) Notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary, including, without limitation,
      the provisions of the act of April 6, 1979 (P.L. 17, No. 5),1referred to as the Pennsylvania Savings Association Insurance Corporation Act, or
      any bylaws, rules or regulations issued pursuant thereto, a PSAIC insured association
      which complies with the filing requirements of section 823 shall withdraw from the
      PSAIC by providing written notice of withdrawal to the board of directors of the PSAIC
      and shall receive a refund of the association's capital deposit to the extent that
      it exists within sixty days of the written notice.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article IX. Investment Operations›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-141. Loans on security of real estate
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article IX. Investment Operations › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-141. Loans on security of real estate
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-141. Loans on security of real estate (2023)
content:
An association may make a loan or participate in making loans or buy or sell participations
   in loans secured by a mortgage which is a lien on real estate located in the regular
   lending area of the association, owned by the borrower in fee or in which he has a
   leasehold interest.  The total of all liens held by an association and all prior liens against real estate
   shall not exceed the maximum percentages of fair market value set forth in the subsections
   of this article.  The loan shall be evidenced by a bond, note or other evidence of indebtedness and
   shall be made upon the security, terms and conditions and in the amount set forth
   in this article for such loan.  Mortgage loans and participations shall be primarily on one to four family residential
   properties.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-132. Reserves
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-132. Reserves
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-132. Reserves (2023)
content:
(a) Every association shall maintain general reserves which shall be used solely for
      the purpose of absorbing losses.  Such reserves shall consist of all or any of the following:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-134. Cashing checks for senior citizens
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-134. Cashing checks for senior citizens
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-134. Cashing checks for senior citizens (2023)
content:
An institution shall after proper identification of payee cash, without charge, any
   State or Federal Government check presented for payment by the payee of the check
   who is a senior citizen sixty-five years of age or older.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article IX. Investment Operations›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-142. Eighty percent loans on properties designed primarily for residential use by not more than four families
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article IX. Investment Operations › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-142. Eighty percent loans on properties designed primarily for residential use by not more than four families
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-142. Eighty percent loans on properties designed primarily for residential use by not more than four families (2023)
content:
An association may make a mortgage loan on the security of real estate on which there
   is erected a building, a substantial portion of which is used as a one to four family
   residential structure or upon the security of real estate upon which such a building
   is to be erected and the loan is made for financing the construction of such building.  A loan made under this section shall not exceed eighty percent of the fair market
   value of the property.  An association may make a mortgage loan which exceeds eighty percent but does not
   exceed ninety percent of the fair market value of a one to four family residential
   structure or upon the security of real estate upon which such a building is to be
   erected and the loan is made for financing the construction of such building:  Provided,
   That the principal portion of the loan in excess of seventy-five percent of the value
   is insured with a private mortgage guaranty company licensed to do business in the
   Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and approved by the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-133. Account insurance
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-133. Account insurance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-133. Account insurance (2023)
content:
(a) Each association subject to this act shall obtain insurance of accounts as soon
      as the association can qualify for such coverage as provided by the Federal Deposit
      Insurance Corporation or the National Credit Union Administration.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-135. Dividends on Permanent Reserve Fund Stock
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VIII. Savings Operations, Earnings, Account Insurance and Reserves › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-135. Dividends on Permanent Reserve Fund Stock
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-135. Dividends on Permanent Reserve Fund Stock (2023)
content:
An association may not more frequently than it credits or pays earnings to savings
   accounts pay a dividend on permanent reserve fund stock subject to the following conditions:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article IX. Investment Operations›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-146. Insured or guaranteed loans
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article IX. Investment Operations › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-146. Insured or guaranteed loans
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-146. Insured or guaranteed loans (2023)
content:
The maximum limitations on loans set forth in sections 902 through 905 inclusive,1as to percentage of fair market value of properties on which loans are made, shall
   not apply to loans insured or guaranteed in whole or in part by the United States,
   or by the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, or any instrumentality of either of them or
   if there is a commitment to so insure or guarantee.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article IX. Investment Operations›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-144. Seventy-five percent loans on properties designed primarily for residential use by five or more families
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article IX. Investment Operations › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-144. Seventy-five percent loans on properties designed primarily for residential use by five or more families
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-144. Seventy-five percent loans on properties designed primarily for residential use by five or more families (2023)
content:
An association may make a mortgage loan not exceeding seventy-five percent of the
   fair market value of a property designed primarily for residential use by five or
   more families or upon the security of real estate on which such a building is to be
   erected or upon the security of real estate on which a building consisting of dwelling
   units used to house persons affiliated with a college, university, hospital or other
   institution is erected or to be erected.  The department may by regulation authorize loans in excess of seventy-five percent
   of the fair market value on any or all of the aforedescribed properties.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article IX. Investment Operations›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-143. Over eighty percent loans on one family residential properties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article IX. Investment Operations › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-143. Over eighty percent loans on one family residential properties
